title: The front door
caption: A question starts the experience
headline: The homepage asks you to participate before it explains the product.
insight: A real question sits beside the promise: one question, nine perspectives. Visitors can contribute anonymously, then enter the discussion; the personality library and practical guides give them more ways to explore why people react differently.

branches.title: The product is the introduction
branches.description: The homepage contains the answer-and-reveal experience itself, with an anonymous posting path and a clear explanation of what will be published.

branches.title: One connected reading journey
branches.description: Personality analyses, Enneagram explainers, practical guides, and community questions share the same navigation and visual language.

branches.title: A useful fallback
branches.description: The implementation can show an explicitly labeled practice exercise when a live question is unavailable. AI-written examples are distinguished from member answers.

title: Answer first
caption: Your take before the room’s
headline: A discussion system built to protect the first honest answer.
insight: Other people’s answers stay hidden until a visitor contributes. Voice capture turns a spoken thought into editable text, and reply notifications can bring a participant back to the specific conversation.

branches.title: The gate lives on the server
branches.description: The answer-first rule controls the response payload as well as the interface, keeping unrevealed answers out of the initial page data.

branches.title: Speak, then review
branches.description: The composer accepts a voice transcript for editing before posting. The recorder also has a browser-transcript fallback when audio refinement is unavailable.

branches.title: A reply has a return path
branches.description: An optional reply-notification tray and focused return view reconnect the participant to the relevant thread.

evidence: src/routes/questions/[slug]/+page.svelte: commentsUnlocked and give-first payload guarantee

title: Find your type
caption: A branching conversation
headline: Turn a founder’s typing conversation into a product that makes room for uncertainty.
insight: The free test begins with anger, shame, or fear, checks the associated strength, and introduces the types in that group. Conflicting answers can open both groups; a tiebreak can retain two types. A friend can give an independent read before seeing the original picks.

branches.title: Branches reflect real hesitation
branches.description: Alternative prompts, strength mismatches, a none-fit path, and a two-type result preserve ambiguity instead of forcing a confident label.

branches.title: An independent second read
branches.description: The friend flow withholds the test-taker’s choices until the friend answers, then compares the two perspectives.

branches.title: A result with somewhere to go
branches.description: The result connects to type reading, a question, and the friend link. The test has no email wall and makes no scientific-validity or accuracy-percentage claim.

title: Personality dossiers
caption: A recognizable editorial product
headline: Public figures become a way into patterns of motivation.
insight: An extensive personality library combines long-form analyses, type context, related reading, and a distinctive portrait treatment. The visual uses actual Jack Black, Dario Amodei, and Sydney Sweeney artwork already featured by 9takes. These are editorial interpretations, not clinical assessments.

branches.title: A library with real depth
branches.description: The repository’s October 28, 2026 corpus snapshot records 462 published personality entries, organized by Enneagram type and domains such as music, film, and technology.

branches.title: A signature portrait system
branches.description: Monochrome portraits, selective color, and the violet eye treatment make the personality series recognizable across the site.

branches.title: Publishing beyond static pages
branches.description: Personality articles load from a database-backed publishing system, with related-person ranking and a content board supporting the growing library.

gallery.alt: 9takes editorial portrait of Jack Black with a violet mark across the eyes and a colorful shirt
gallery.caption: Actual personality-series artwork. The portrait is an editorial treatment of a public figure, not an endorsement.

title: The publishing system
caption: Research, review, and original art
headline: The content library has an editorial workflow behind every new draft.
insight: The site spans personality analyses, relationship guides, Enneagram education, and pop-culture essays. Its publishing tooling connects research, claim-level evidence, independent reviews, revision, and verification. Original sculptural covers carry the same identity from one topic to the next.

branches.title: Claims carry their context
branches.description: The evidence model separates observation, self-report, third-party claims, interpretation, disputed material, and unknowns, with source references and alternative explanations.

branches.title: Review stays attached to the draft
branches.description: Content hashes tie review and verification to the text being assessed. Quality gates and unresolved blockers determine publication eligibility.

branches.title: A maintained web of reading
branches.description: Crosslink checks, corpus reports, image maps, and sitemap generation support the library as it grows.

branches.title: Original covers, consistent language
branches.description: Relationships, conflict, and teamwork use sculptural scenes made for those subjects, giving practical writing a coherent visual identity.

title: Behind the community
caption: Moderation with guarded decisions
headline: The community needs a working back office as much as a welcoming front door.
insight: Dedicated administration supports questions, categories, comments, content, and analytics. Flagged comments can be cleared or removed through guarded server actions, with pending-state checks and recovery when part of an update fails.

branches.title: Review has a defined lifecycle
branches.description: Pending flags can be cleared or removed. Actions reject flags already handled, reducing conflicting decisions when a queue changes.

branches.title: Recovery is part of the action
branches.description: If the comment update fails after its flags change, the action attempts to roll back that flag transition. Comment counts are refreshed separately with a visible warning on failure.

branches.title: Demo and administrator boundaries
branches.description: The source checks administrator access before loading moderation data or applying actions, and disables moderation writes while demo mode is enabled.

evidence: src/routes/admin/comments/+page.server.ts: validateAdmin, removeComment, unflagComment, rollback, demo guard

title: The visual world
caption: Marble, lamplight, nine expressions
headline: A personality platform with a visual identity built around human expression.
insight: Nine marble masks turn a system of personality differences into a recognizable mark. Greek figures in conversation, warm pools of light, and sculptural editorial scenes extend the idea across the product. A documented token system connects those images to the interface.

branches.title: The nine-mask mark
branches.description: A grid of distinct expressions makes the premise visible before a visitor reads a word.

branches.title: One conversation across settings
branches.description: The homepage’s original conversation scenes reinterpret the gathering across generations and eras, including a circle of Greek statues in Athens.

branches.title: Art direction reaches the UI
branches.description: Warm stone surfaces, sodium amber, Inter, and monospaced annotations form the current design language. The personality portrait series keeps its deliberate violet media treatment.
